args.command:
PORT=3456 node server.js > /tmp/books.log 2>&1 &
S=$!; sleep 0.7

echo "created -> $LOC"
curl -s "$LOC" | grep -o "Frank Herbert\|Hook line.\|Mark as finished\|http://localhost:3456/books/[a-f0-9-]*" | sort -u
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish:%{http_code}\n" -X POST "$LOC/finish"
curl -s "$LOC" | grep -c "Currently reading" 
kill $S; sleep 0.3

S2=$!; sleep 0.7
curl -s localhost:3457/ | grep -c "Dune"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3457/books/nope
kill $S2

Done. Run `npm start` → http://localhost:3000. Books live in `data/books.json` (created on first add, survives restarts).

- `/` — currently reading, finished, and an add-book form (title, author, optional notes)
- `/books/<id>` — detail page with notes you can edit, a "Mark as finished" button, and a copyable share link that works for anyone who can reach the server
- Zero dependencies (`server.js`, `lib/store.js`, `lib/views.js`); 14 vitest tests cover persistence, routing, and XSS-escaping
